prepare_wenetspeech4tts_dataset: run the WenetSpeech4TTS dataset preparation script to preprocess audio and text into arrow format
process_sub_path_files: process a sub-directory of text and wav files to extract audio paths, texts, and durations
convert_text_to_pinyin: convert Chinese characters to pinyin with optional polyphone resolution using convert_char_to_pinyin
save_arrow_dataset: save preprocessed dataset records to an arrow file using Dataset.from_dict and save_to_disk
generate_duration_json: create a duration.json file containing a list of all audio durations for DynamicBatchSampler usage
build_vocab_file: generate a sorted vocab.txt tokenizer file from all unique characters in the processed text
